correctness.rationale: The core argument was reconstructed from definitions. An internal up-beat witness in a fiber remains below every point in each higher comparable fiber, and dually for down-beat witnesses, so any chosen fiber reduction sequence remains valid globally. After all fibers are replaced by nontrivial minimal cores, a point with internal comparable points cannot acquire a cross-fiber beat witness because an internal point lies on the wrong side of every higher/lower fiber. If it is maximal/minimal internally, any cross-fiber minimum/maximum witness would force a global minimum/maximum in one nontrivial minimal core, impossible because such an extremum creates a beat point. Hence the terminal lexicographic sum is beat-point-free and is a Stong core. The singleton-below-two-antichain example correctly shows failure when a contractible fiber is allowed. Independent tiny lexicographic-sum checks over chain and V-shaped indices found no beat points after substitution by nontrivial antichain cores.
